title: Speak clearly: pace, pauses and stress
objective: Parler avec débit, pauses et intonation favorisant l'intelligibilité

steps.title: Warm-up: too fast, too slow
steps.student_instruction: Read the same sentence very fast, very slowly, then at a good pace. Which one is the clearest?
steps.facilitator_instruction: Démonstration puis essai en binômes ; faire verbaliser ce qui aide l'auditeur.

steps.title: Listening: Amazing facts
steps.student_instruction: Listen to two friends sharing amazing facts. Note the numbers and how the speaker says them.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Faire écouter l'audio British Council (QR code) ; sans réseau, lire le script de secours en ralentissant sur les nombres. Repérer pauses et accents.

steps.title: Language focus: chunks and pauses
steps.student_instruction: Split sentences into chunks of 3 to 6 words, mark pauses (/) and stress one key word per chunk.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Modéliser au tableau ; lecture chorale du texte modèle avec pauses marquées.

steps.title: Differentiated practice
steps.student_instruction: Complete your A, B or C sheet and rehearse with a partner.
steps.facilitator_instruction: A : texte pré-découpé ; B : découper et marquer seul ; C : préparer et chronométrer un mini-exposé.

steps.title: Amazing fact presentations
steps.student_instruction: Present a 45-second amazing fact. The group gives feedback on pace, pauses and stress.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Grille : débit, pauses, mots accentués, contact visuel ; deux retours positifs et un conseil par présentation.

steps.title: Exit ticket
steps.student_instruction: Write one sentence with its pauses (/) and stressed words in capitals.

sheets.student_content: Read the model text with the pauses already marked (/). Underline one key word in each chunk, then read it to a partner twice.
sheets.facilitator_correction: Exemple : Did you KNOW / that your BODY / is HOME / to millions of BACTERIA? Mots-clés variables si cohérents.

sheets.student_content: Mark the pauses (/) and the key words in this text, then read it in about 20 seconds: Most bacteria in your body are helpful because they help you digest food and protect you from illness.
sheets.facilitator_correction: Most BACTERIA in your body / are HELPFUL / because they help you DIGEST food / and PROTECT you / from ILLNESS.

sheets.student_content: Prepare a 45-second presentation of an amazing fact. Mark chunks, pauses and key words, time yourself and record one version to improve.
sheets.facilitator_correction: Production libre ; critères : débit adapté (environ 120 à 150 mots par minute), pauses logiques, accentuation des mots-clés et des nombres.

criteria: L'élève parle à un débit permettant la compréhension
L'élève marque des pauses aux bons endroits
L'élève accentue les mots-clés et les nombres

common_errors: Pauses au milieu d'un groupe de mots
